PDF sanitization / preview and redactions
Experimental · processed in your browser

          
          

            
▤

            
Select a PDF

            
We detect patterns in extractable text and suggest redactions on the pages. You can add redactions manually before exporting.

            
            
            
Up to 25 MB and 30 pages. Processing is offline. Scanned documents have no OCR and need manual review.

Page 1

                

                
Drag on the page to draw a redaction. Click the × on any rectangle to remove it (including automatic ones). Check every page.

              

              

                
Review the information

                

                
Automatic redactions may cover an entire line to avoid leaving part of a secret visible. The tool does not recognize images, faces or all personal data.

                

                  
                  
                  
                

                
                

                  Warning: the PDF will be converted to images
                  
The new PDF will retain page appearance and order, but text will no longer be selectable or searchable. Forms, links, digital signatures and text accessibility will be lost.

                

                
                
              

            

          

          
Privacy: the original PDF stays in your browser; the output is a new document with black pixels applied to the images. Review the result before sharing. Scanned PDFs require manual redactions; automatic detection does not guarantee anonymization.
